meta.name: review
meta.description: Review a proposed customer code change against its intended outcome and operational risks. Use for a diff or PR review; report evidence and actionable findings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动对照预期目标和运行风险过一遍,给出带证据的可执行结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果合并前想把改动风险看清、并留下书面结论
copy.tagline_en: Check a code change against its goal and operational risks, with evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want risks surfaced before merging a change.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会审查客户提交的代码改动(diff 或 PR),对照预期结果与运维风险,给出带证据、可执行的发现。它直接基于你提供的上下文工作,不需要初始化。
howto.when: 当你需要审查某个 diff 或 PR 时触发。若由 @fde 调用,则复用它当前的脱敏数据包与范围,不重新做设置、探索或已答过的问题。

say.text: 帮我审一下这个 PR 的改动
say.note: 会对照预期结果给出带证据的发现

say.text: 这个 diff 有哪些运维风险?
say.note: 会区分实现、验证、部署与验收

say.text: 审这个改动,并列出未运行的检查
say.note: 缺能力或未跑的检查会如实说明

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reviews a customer code change (a diff or PR) against its intended outcome and operational risks, reporting evidence-backed, actionable findings. It works from the context you supply and needs no setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a diff or PR reviewed. If called by @fde, it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup, discovery, or already answered questions.

say_en.text: Review this PR's changes for me
say_en.note: Reports evidence-backed findings against the intended outcome

say_en.text: What operational risks does this diff carry?
Review this change and list unrun checks
